instructions_tools_hint: Define the agent role, behavior, and constraints. All native Dome tools and skills are available automatically — you only choose MCP servers separately.
instructions_placeholder: Example: You are an experienced horticulturist specializing in native meadows and drought-tolerant gardens. Help plan low-water landscapes based on location, climate, and local plants.
role_message: Which Dome edition fits you? Pro is the default: documents and people. Study and Dev are specialized apps on the same platform. You can switch later in Settings.
role_about_placeholder: I'm Alder, I focus on programming and tracking my projects…
role_about_hint: I'll use this to shape how I assist you and what I remember about you.
welcome_message:
Hi! I’m Many, your assistant in Dome.

I’ll set up Dome with you in a couple of minutes. First, pick the language you want to use.
profile_message: Tell me a little about yourself. This will help me personalize your experience in Dome.
ai_message:
Now choose how I think. Use your Dome account, an API key you already have, or a model running on this computer.

You can change it any time in Settings.
complete_message:
Perfect! Everything is configured.

I'm ready to help you work with your resources. If you need to change any settings later, you can do so from the settings panel.

Welcome to Dome!

permissions_message:
To transcribe meetings, I need to hear the microphone and, if you want, the audio from other apps.

Nothing is recorded until you press record.
permissions_subtitle: macOS will ask you to confirm. You can skip this and grant them the first time you transcribe.
permissions_later: You can review these later in Settings → AI → Transcription.
